jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: Please note that Insurity will only reach out to interview, make an offer of employment, or conduct onboarding activities for candidates who have applied through our careers site. When interviewing for a position, the candidate experience will include live interaction, such as a video or telephone call , with a Recruiter and/or company employee(s). We will never ask for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process. Recruiters will only reach out from an insurity.com email address; no other email addresses will be used. Examples of fraudulent email addresses that have been used end with @insurityjobs.us. Be aware of suspicious recruitment activity. If you think you are a victim of an employment scam, you may contact your local law enforcement agency and/or visit the Federal Trade Commission website here: https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams .     Who We Are Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. Just as importantly, we empower our people—providing the tools, support, and opportunities they need to grow and succeed. We don’t just make bold promises—we deliver results. As the largest cloud-based software provider for the Property & Casualty market, Insurity is trusted by 22 of the top 25 P&C carriers and 7 of the top 10 wholesale brokers in the MGA space. Behind that trust is a team that delivers exceptional value and deep industry expertise. While our technology sets us apart, it’s our people who truly make the difference. At Insurity, you’ll collaborate with some of the most creative and knowledgeable minds in insurance tech—in a culture that fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning. Our award-winning onboarding experience ensures you feel welcomed and supported from the moment you accept our offer to join the company. Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you. #UatInsurity Insurity’s Next Customer Success Manager   We’re seeking a dynamic and versatile Customer Success Manager to join our team and play a pivotal role in driving customer success, solution adoption, and strategic growth within our Insurity Marine Suite (IMS) product group. This cross-functional role blends Sales, Customer Success, Solution Consulting, and Product Expertise to deliver value to our P&C Insurance customers. You’ll be responsible for building strong in-person relationships with key stakeholders and partnering with our customers to ensure their strategic business objectives are understood and that their utilization of the Insurity Marine Suite Product is appropriately leveraged to drive these objectives.  This role requires domain knowledge in Marine Cargo Insurance, is based in London, and requires regular in-person engagement with clients and partners.  What Our Customer Success Manager Will Do   Relationship Management  Primary point of management contact for assigned customers  Accurately capture minutes / actions from meetings  Prepare professional presentations/reports and effectively lead customer meetings  Ensure workflow management system and customer-facing tools are up to date  Provide tool self-service support for customers  Understand Customer KPIs; measure and track regularly  Maintain/manage customer expectations and satisfaction  Develop working relationships with Customer System Champions  Independently transition low complexity customers from the implementation team  Ensure contract compliance and accurate billing  Understand the customer experience and loyalty measures in place (NPS, references, etc.)  Ensure a strong understanding of internal customer organization, political landscape, and stakeholder personalities  Demonstrate thorough knowledge of customers’ business challenges, opportunities and how   our products and solutions address them  Uncover potential cross-sell and upsell opportunities Enhancement Delivery   Facilitate end-to-end management of cross-functional medium complexity enhancements in accordance with product specific procedures. Draft change requests and Statements of Work for small to medium complexity enhancements Demonstrate an understanding of revenue recognition and account measurements Internal Process Demonstrate competency in all internal processes & practices Support Continuous Improvement initiatives Provide mentorship to team members Stay up to date on industry and job-related trends and best practices, including reading relevant publications, articles, blogs, etc. Other duties as assigned Who We’re Looking For   Minimum 1- 3 years' experience in Marine Cargo Insurance, Logistics or Logistics Software Minimum 1-3 years' experience minimum in customer success related role, interfacing and working directly with customers. jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities Manage quotations and orders by preparing quotes and order forms, reviewing purchase orders, coordinating approvals, and ensuring accurate handovers between Commercial and operational teams. Coordinate order processing and license provisioning, ensuring customer and partner information is complete and resolving operational blockers efficiently. Support invoicing and accounts receivable activities by ensuring invoice readiness, coordinating with Finance, monitoring invoice status and overdue receivables, and resolving billing or documentation issues. Manage renewal operations by maintaining visibility of upcoming renewals, coordinating preparation across relevant teams and partners, and proactively tracking risks and outstanding actions. Support distributor and commercial partner operations, including onboarding, documentation, system access, internal setup, and alignment with operational processes. Coordinate operational requirements for new EMEA markets, working across Commercial, Legal, Finance, Regulatory, Customer Success, and HQ teams. Take ownership of day-to-day commercial operational issues by establishing clear owners and deadlines, coordinating stakeholders, removing bottlenecks, and driving matters through to resolution. Identify recurring operational challenges and develop scalable processes that improve turnaround times, reduce rework, and minimize unnecessary escalations to senior management. Monitor operational performance through metrics such as order-processing times, provisioning lead times, renewal readiness, partner onboarding, AR follow-up, and completion of agreed actions. Requirements: Approximately 4–7 years of experience in Business Operations, Commercial Operations, Order Management, or a related operational role. Experience supporting B2B commercial operations, preferably across multiple countries or international markets. Strong understanding of quotations, purchase orders, invoicing, renewals, and order-to-cash processes. Proven ability to coordinate effectively across Commercial, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Operations, and external stakeholders. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and reliable follow-through. Comfortable working independently and taking initiative in a fast-growing, evolving environment where processes may still be developing. Experience using CRM platforms and other business systems to manage operational workflows and information. Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders across different functions and geographies. Experience in SaaS, healthcare, medical devices, healthcare IT, or another technology-driven environment is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn operational issues into practical, repeatable solutions. Benefits: Full-time employment under an Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement. Fully remote work-from-home setup with occasional business travel. Opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across multiple countries and global teams. 30 days of paid time off. Onboarding gifts and home-office equipment or supplies. Training and professional development opportunities. Exposure to an international, fast-growing healthcare technology environment. Opportunity to take meaningful ownership of commercial operations and contribute to the development of scalable processes. How Jobgether works: We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. #LI-CL1

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager - EMEA
jobs.description: About Remote Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote. With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.   If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work! What this job can offer you This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Senior Account Manager , joining our Existing Business team. In this role, you'll manage and grow a portfolio of existing customers across Remote's full product suite — including EOR, Global Payroll, Contractor of Record (COR), and other solutions — expanding relationships with complex, multi-stakeholder organizations. You'll be a trusted advisor to senior buyers, comfortable navigating multi-threaded deals, and driven to find the right solution for the customer rather than getting stuck on obstacles along the way. As a senior member of the team, you'll also have the opportunity to share best practice with peers and help shape how Existing Business approaches multi-product growth. jobs.title: CX Operations Manager, Tooling
jobs.description: About Remote Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote. With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.   If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work! What this job can offer you You will own and improve the platforms Customer Experience runs on: Zendesk, Vitally, and the integrations that connect them to the rest of the stack. This is hands-on platform work with real scope. You configure, automate, integrate, and maintain systems used every day by support and customer success teams. You work with autonomy on agreed priorities, use automation (including AI-assisted workflows where they fit), and partner with operations and technical teams when a problem needs more than configuration alone. You will see work through from scoping to production and ongoing ownership: testing changes, communicating with affected teams, documenting what you ship, and keeping platforms reliable as requirements grow. How this role contributes to the department's and company's goals Remote's CX organization depends on reliable tooling: routing that works, automations that hold up under load, and platforms that specialists can trust. This role keeps that foundation solid as the business and product surface area grow. You will help CX scale without adding friction: fewer manual workarounds, clearer workflows, and platform changes that ship with proper testing, communication, and documentation. Strong platform operations also creates the conditions for automation and AI initiatives to land safely. The work sits close to the teams who use these tools every day, so the impact is direct and measurable. What you bring Strong ownership and autonomy: you spot what needs doing, set direction, and deliver without heavy oversight. Hands-on Zendesk experience in a production support environment: triggers, automations, views, groups, routing, macros, and comfort debugging via the API when needed. Platform operations experience in CX or customer success: you understand how support and CSM teams work, not just how admin screens are laid out. End-to-end delivery: scoping, stakeholder alignment, safe rollout, and steady-state ownership after go-live. Documentation as part of how you work. Accurate, accessible docs are part of done, not an afterthought. Sound judgment on when configuration or automation is the right fix, and when the problem needs a different approach. Automation experience in CX: low/no-code tools (Zapier, platform-native automations, or similar) and workflows that hold up in production. Practical familiarity with AI in support and success operations: agent assist, workflow automation, triage or routing helpers, or knowledge-backed tools. You do not need to be an ML engineer, but you should be comfortable working with AI-enabled workflows and knowing where they help versus add noise. Comfort with APIs, webhooks, and integration patterns; able to partner with engineering on harder problems. Depth in Zendesk or a comparable support platform. Vitally or similar Customer Success platform experience is a strong plus. Willingness to work across more than one system in the stack. Clear written and spoken English. Remote-first experience is a plus. Key Responsibilities  Platform administration and reliability Administer Zendesk, Vitally, and related CX tools: configuration, access, and day-to-day operational health. Own intake, triage, and delivery for platform requests from internal teams. Maintain documentation for configurations, automations, and integrations. Workflow, automation, and AI-enabled tooling Design and maintain triggers, automations, and data flows that reduce manual handling and keep work moving reliably through CX systems. Build and run integrations across the CX stack using APIs, webhooks, and low-code tools where that is the right tradeoff. Identify automation opportunities from ticket data, workflow friction, and team feedback; ship practical improvements, not automation for its own sake. Support AI-enabled workflows in CX (for example agent assist, routing or triage helpers, and intake automation): configure, test, document, and iterate with appropriate oversight and change control. Follow change management practices: test before production, communicate impact, document intent and ownership. Continuous improvement Use operational data and platform metrics to prioritize work and measure results. Identify fragile configs, process gaps, and technical debt; address them in a structured way. Support rollout of new channels, integrations, and workflow changes as CX requirements evolve. Cross-functional partnership Work with support, success, and operations teams to understand workflow needs and validate solutions before they ship. Partner with enablement on training and adoption when tooling changes affect frontline teams. Collaborate with product, engineering, and data teams on integrations and escalations that go beyond platform configuration.   Practicals You'll report to: Senior Manager, CX Operations Team: Customer Experience - CX Operations Location : For this position we welcome everyone to apply, but we will prioritize applications from Europe and the Americas. Start date: As soon as possible Application process Interview with recruiter Interview with f

searchJobs.title: Influencer Marketing Account Manager
searchJobs.description: Accountabilities Manage day-to-day communication and relationships with international influencers and content creators. Coordinate influencer marketing campaigns from initial planning through execution, publication, and performance reporting. Review and approve creator content before publication, ensuring compliance with campaign guidelines, brand requirements, and quality standards. Monitor key campaign metrics including engagement, clicks, conversions, promotional codes, and overall performance. Maintain accurate and up-to-date campaign information across Monday.com, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, and similar tools. Identify high-performing influencers and analyze campaign results to uncover opportunities for optimization and future collaborations. Research, approach, evaluate, and recruit new creators who align with client objectives, audiences, and campaign requirements. Track campaign deliverables, deadlines, creator commitments, and other operational requirements. Prepare performance reports and provide ongoing updates on campaign progress and results. Identify content errors, inconsistencies, or process gaps and take appropriate action to maintain campaign quality. Manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously while maintaining strong organization and attention to detail. Requirements 2–4 years of professional experience in influencer marketing, account management, digital marketing, or a related field. Strong understanding of influencer marketing campaigns, creator partnerships, engagement, conversions, and performance metrics. Professional or advanced English proficiency, both written and conversational. Experience using project management, CRM, or campaign management platforms such as Monday.com, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, or comparable tools. Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail. Ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and potential issues in content, campaign tracking, and operational processes. Strong analytical and results-oriented mindset, with the ability to interpret campaign metrics and translate insights into actionable improvements. Excellent communication and relationship-management skills when working with influencers, clients, and internal stakeholders. Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Availability to work according to a Cyprus-based schedule, Sunday through Thursday, starting at 9:30 a.m. EEST. Willingness to sign confidentiality agreements when required. Ability to align professional social media

searchJobs.title: Property Management Account Manager
searchJobs.description: Accountabilities Serve as the primary point of contact for client and tenant communications, managing relationships professionally and ensuring timely, effective responses. Oversee the day-to-day operations of an assigned property portfolio, maintaining high standards of service and operational performance. Manage a portfolio that may range from approximately 70 units for standard performers to 350 units for top performers. Handle daily communication workflows, primarily through written correspondence and email, with occasional outbound phone calls. Take ownership of portfolio growth, with an initial target of approximately 100 units and the opportunity to scale to 150, 200, or more units based on performance. Coordinate workflows and oversee team performance, including supervising, guiding, and holding Virtual Assistants accountable. Identify and resolve unusual or complex operational issues that may fall outside established procedures, manuals, or FAQs. Apply critical thinking, initiative, and sound judgment to determine appropriate solutions in ambiguous situations. De-escalate conflicts with clients and tenants calmly and professionally while maintaining positive relationships. Adapt quickly to changing priorities and operational demands while maintaining a high level of service and attention to detail. Requirements: Previous professional experience in property management, particularly as a Leasing Agent, Property Management Assistant, Property Manager, or in a comparable property operations position. Demonstrated ability to oversee daily property operations, workflows, and team performance. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence managing clients, tenants, and team members. Experience supervising, guiding, delegating to, and holding Virtual Assistants or remote team members accountable. Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the confidence to make sound decisions when situations are complex or solutions are not explicitly documented. Highly adaptable and resourceful, with a proactive, self-directed, and autodidactic approach to learning and problem-solving. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment. Calm and professional approach to conflict resolution, with resilience and a consistently positive attitude. Availability to work U.S. business hours. A quiet, dedicated home-office environment suitable for professional calls and focused work. Reliable internet connection of at least 10 Mbps, with a backup internet connection
